security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Private file sharing with nearby devices
bundle.longDescription: Private, account-free file sharing over the local network with Bluetooth fallback on supported devices. Trusted devices, explicit receiver approval, verified streaming and resumable transfers. Optional audio conversion uses a separately selected FFmpeg executable; FFmpeg is not bundled.
